data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Hima is a goddess of the earth, and Priyaa means 'loved'. This name signifies being cherished and protected by the divine earth goddess. The name Himapriyaa carries the meaning “Loved by God Hima” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Himapriyaa usually hope their child will grow to embody loved by god hima and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Himapriyaa was the name of a celestial nymph or apsara in Hindu mythology who was known for her beauty and grace. She was one of the sixty-four Khandavasenani apsaras who graced the Khandava forest during the Mahabharata war. Himapriyaa's name is derived from 'Hima' which means snow and 'Priyaa' which means dear or beloved.

Himapriyaa is also the name of a Hindu goddess who is the consort of the god Himavat. Himapriyaa was believed to be the goddess of snow and the mother of the Himalayas. She is mentioned in various Hindu texts, including the Mahabharata, the Puranas, and the Atharvaveda.
